text:
ada: taking the evening oncall (18:30 PST). quick snapshot — no incident, just a few things to watch and a couple action items.
- changed: rolling restart of embedder-2 pool finished at 18:10 UTC, pods back up, healthchecks green.
- watch: eu-west prefetched-kv eviction experiment is showing higher eviction rates — keep an eye on small-requests tail latency and SLOs.
- FYI: qa running a short burst test against /v1/generate (burst=200) for 20m; canary fallback to gpt-small is enabled.
- action items: @frank please prioritize PR #4832 (autoscaler fix). @dmitri pls verify TTL revert plan if latencies worsen. @ben monitor dedicated pool alerts and queue depth.
- how to check quickly: `kubectl get pods -n inference | egrep "(embedder|router)"` and `curl -sS https://deploy-ci.example.com/status | jq .last_deploy`
- If you need to page: ada_pager. I'll post a mid-shift status at ~19:00.

ben: thanks — noted. I'll watch queue depth and set a short loop to sample redis. if alerts > 5min or queue depth spikes i'll escalate here.

ci-bot: deploy finished: embedder-2 v1.14.3 -> v1.14.4 by @elaine at 18:08 UTC — all checks passed. :white_check_mark:

dmitri: saw a ~3% tail increase right after the prefetch change earlier today. rule of thumb: if tail > +2% vs baseline for 10m, revert prefetched TTL change. i'll run a small monitor script and post results if it crosses threshold.

elaine: confirming embedder restart was a hotfix for rare OOM on 4GB cards — no config flips besides image. canary ramped to 5% then to 20% after health was stable.

frank: picking up PR #4832 now, ETA ~45m. will ping if i need a second pair of eyes. :thumbsup:

ada: (added for completeness) — current watchlist: eu-west kv eviction, small-requests tail latency, canary error rate. please drop any anomalies into this thread instead of DMs so we have a record. thanks all.
